newsitem.title: USA: L.A. mayor's choice for transit agency rejects job.
newsitem.headline: L.A. mayor's choice for transit agency rejects job.

text.p: An executive tapped by Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan to lead the county's troubled Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) has turned down the job, according to a published report on Wednesday.
Bechtel Corp executive Theodore Weigle Jr told Los Angeles city and county officials he would stay with the multinational construction firm, the Los Angeles Times reported.

Riordan, who will become MTA board chairman on July 1, expressed disappointment over Weigle's decision and said finding another strong candidate for the job would be one of his top priorities, the Times reported.
